description:
Enables Windows Firewall on Domain, Private, and Public profiles with default inbound block and outbound allow, local rule merge disabled, and stealth mode on. Use the companion Windows Firewall Rules - Exemptions Device policy to add any exemptions needed, such as your RMM tool. 

Apply to All Devices (optionally with filters) or Entra ID device groups.
name: Windows Microsoft Defender Firewall baseline Device
